tools.name: get_practice_info
tools.description: Facts about Foundations Counseling LLC, a private-pay, talk-therapy practice in Northern Colorado with offices in Fort Collins (2), Loveland, and Windsor, plus online sessions: what it offers, what it does not provide, payment model, languages, and how to start. Use this first for general questions

tools.name: find_counselors
tools.description: List Foundations counselors, optionally filtered by service (use list_services for ids), office, Spanish-language counseling, online sessions, or the client's age. For a child or teen, pass their age: each counselor's published ages differ (for example 4+, 12+, 3-12 and 18+), and the child-teen-ther

tools.name: get_counselor
tools.description: Published profile for one Foundations counselor: credentials as listed, offices, ages and populations served, therapies, education, services and approaches, and profile URL. Does not include availability, which is never published per counselor.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: All talk-therapy services Foundations lists, grouped the way the website groups them: who we help, what we help with, and how we work (approaches). Each service has an id usable with find_counselors and get_service. Discontinued offerings such as group therapy and seminars are excluded.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: One service: summary, page URL, which counselors list it on their profiles, and which offices they practice in.

tools.name: get_locations
tools.description: The four Foundations offices (Fort Collins Horsetooth Road, Fort Collins Harmony Road, Loveland, Windsor): addresses, hours, phone, map links, and which counselors practice at each.

tools.name: get_fees_and_insurance
tools.description: Session fee, free first consultation, private-pay model, insurance (not in-network; documentation provided for out-of-network reimbursement), accepted payment methods including HSA and FSA, and the cancellation policy, exactly as Foundations publishes them.

tools.name: how_to_start
tools.description: The steps to begin counseling at Foundations, in order: reach out and share what you need, get matched with a counselor, have a free consultation with that matched counselor, then begin sessions. Includes the phone number, booking link, scheduling hours, and the Counselor Match Guarantee.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Practice-level availability for new clients, optionally for one office or online. Returns a verified status with its date when Foundations has published one, otherwise the scheduling statement from the website. Availability is never published for individual counselors; always confirm by phone or the

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search Foundations' Healing Library of mental health articles (general education reviewed by the practice, not clinical advice). Returns titles, summaries, URLs, and review dates. Use for informational questions where a reviewed article helps.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_counselor" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_availability" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_counselor, get_service, search_library · Private data: get_practice_info, get_counselor, get_fees_and_insurance · Public sink: how_to_start.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_counselor, get_service, search_library · Private data: get_practice_info, get_counselor, get_fees_and_insurance · Public sink: how_to_start

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
